How to Play:

- Your objective is to go through the [color=#00ff00]exit doors[/color].
- Pressure plates trigger doors of the same color.
- The player and metal blocks can press pressure plates.

Use the [color=#ffff00]\[Arrows][/color] to move, [color=#ffff00]\[Space][/color] to push/pull metal blocks, and [color=#ffff00]\[Ctrl][/color] to toggle between pushing and pulling.

[color=#ff5555]Warning:[/color] dropping metal boxes in holes will make them unusable. You can always restart a stage by pressing [color=#ffff00]\[Esc][/color].

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Enter][/color] to start...

In this stage, you will encounter force fields, which block pushing and pulling forces. They also instantly vaporize any metal cubes on touch. Fortunately, these barriers won't stop you from moving through them. Look for a pressure plate of the same color to toggle the force field on and off.

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Enter][/color] to start...

In this final stage, you'll encounter tesla coils. These devices have their own pushing and pulling forces. You can temporarily deactivate them by using a pressure plate that matches their color.

[color=#ff5555]Warning:[/color] tesla coils can push or pull metal cubes into bad spots, making them useless for the rest of the puzzle.

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Enter][/color] to start...

[color=#00ff00]Congratulations! You have beaten all the stages.[/color]

Press [color=#ffff00]\[Enter][/color] to restart...
